title: Wasanni da motsa jiki
description: Ten short stories about sport and exercise: a girl learning tennis at a club in Kaduna, a village boy who learns to swim at a lodging in Maiduguri, a hunting contest in the bush near Bauchi, a runner's knee surgery and recovery in Kano, a quarrel in a girls' volleyball team in Gombe, a Sallah ram fight in Katsina, the election of a new chairwoman for a Jos athletics club, a letter about inter-house sports at a Zaria boarding school, a cyclist in Niamey whose bike is stolen before a race and his wedding, and a joint training exercise for cadets in Kaduna.

lessons.title: Hanifa da tennis
lessons.summary: In Kaduna, Hanifa wants to learn tennis; at a club she hires a racket, the coach Malam Gimba makes her repeat every stroke, she keeps at it every day after school, her father orders her own racket, and at the end of the year she wins the girls' tournament.
lessons.text:
Hanifa 'yar shekara goma sha huɗu ce, kuma tana zaune a Kaduna tare da iyayenta. Wata rana ta kalli wasan tennis a talabijin, sai ta ce wa mahaifinta, "Baba, ina so in koyi wasan tennis." Mahaifinta ya ce, "To, akwai wani kulob na tennis a unguwarmu. Gobe za mu je."

Da safe suka je kulob ɗin. Farfajiyar kulob ɗin tana da girma, kuma akwai filayen tennis guda huɗu a cikinta. A ƙofar farfajiyar suka sami Malam Gimba, wanda yake koyar da tennis. Ya ce, "Kuɗin shiga kulob ɗin naira dubu biyar ne a wata. Idan ba ki da raket, za ki iya yin hayar raket a nan. Hayar raket naira ɗari biyar kacal ce a rana." Mahaifinta ya biya kuɗin biyu.

A ranar farko, Malam Gimba ya nuna mata yadda ake riƙe raket da yadda ake buga ƙwallo. Sai ya ce, "Yanzu ki maimaita abin da na yi." Hanifa ta buga ƙwallon, amma ƙwallon ya faɗa cikin raga. Ta sake bugawa, sai ƙwallon ya fita daga filin. Malam Gimba ya ce, "Kada ki damu. Ki maimaita sau goma, sannan sau ashirin."

Hanifa ta jajirce. Kowace rana bayan makaranta, tana zuwa farfajiyar kulob ɗin tana maimaita bugun da malamin ya koya mata. Idan ta gaji, sai ta zauna a ƙarƙashin bishiya ta huta na minti goma, sannan ta koma filin. Malam Gimba ya ce wa mahaifinta, "'Yarka tana da jajircewa. Ba ta yarda ta daina ba, kuma ba ta huta sai ta gaji sosai."

Bayan wata uku, mahaifinta ya ga cewa hayar raket kowace rana tana da tsada. Sai ya yi odar sabon raket daga wani shago a Legas. Bayan kwana biyar, odar ta iso. Hanifa ta ce, "Na gode, Baba. Ba zan ƙara biyan haya ba."

A ƙarshen shekara, kulob ɗin ya shirya gasar tennis ta 'yan mata. Hanifa ta doke 'yan mata uku, ta kai wasan ƙarshe. A wasan ƙarshe ta haɗu da wata yarinya daga Zaria wadda ta zarce ta a tsawo da ƙarfi. Amma Hanifa ta fi ta haƙuri, kuma ta yi kuskure sau ɗaya kacal. Ta ci wasan, ta karɓi kofi.

Malam Gimba ya ce, "Hanifa ta zarce dukan 'yan matan kulob ɗin. Wannan sakamakon jajircewa ne."

Tambayoyi:
Me Hanifa take so ta koya?
Tana so ta koyi wasan tennis.
Nawa ne hayar raket a rana?
Hayar raket naira ɗari biyar kacal ce a rana.
Me ya sa mahaifinta ya yi odar sabon raket?
Ya yi odar sabon raket saboda hayar raket kowace rana tana da tsada.
Yaya Hanifa ta ci wasan ƙarshe?
Yarinyar Zaria ta zarce ta a tsawo da ƙarfi, amma Hanifa ta fi ta haƙuri, kuma ta yi kuskure sau ɗaya kacal.

lessons.title: Fu'ad ya koyi iyo
lessons.summary: Fu'ad, a village boy near Maiduguri, fears deep water because his grandfather warns him about the well; at a lodging with a pool in Maiduguri, the teacher Malama Bashariya teaches him calm, saves a small boy who sinks, and on the last day Fu'ad swims across the pool alone.
lessons.text:
Fu'ad yaro ne ɗan shekara goma sha biyu daga wani ƙauye kusa da Maiduguri. A ƙauyensu babu kogi ko tafki, sai rijiya. Kakansa yakan faɗakar da shi cewa, "Kada ka yi wasa kusa da rijiya. Idan ka faɗa cikinta, za ka nutse." Saboda haka Fu'ad yana tsoron ruwa mai zurfi, kuma bai taɓa koyon iyo ba.

A lokacin hutu, mahaifinsa ya kai shi Maiduguri domin bikin auren wani ɗan'uwansu. Suka sauka a wani masauki kusa da kasuwa. Masaukin yana da wurin iyo a bayansa. Da safe Fu'ad ya ga yara suna iyo a cikin ruwan, suna dariya. Ya so ya shiga, amma yana jin tsoro.

Wata malama mai koyar da iyo a masaukin, Malama Bashariya, ta gan shi tsaye a gefen ruwa. Ta tambaye shi, "Ba ka iya iyo ba?" Ya ce, "A'a. Kakana ya faɗakar da ni cewa ruwa yana da haɗari." Ta ce, "Kakanka ya yi gaskiya. Ruwa yana da haɗari ga wanda bai iya iyo ba. Shi ya sa ya kamata ka koya."

Ta fara koya masa a gefen da ruwan ba shi da zurfi. Ta ce, "Abu na farko shi ne nutsuwa. Idan ka firgita, za ka nutse. Idan kana da nutsuwa, ruwa zai ɗauke ka." Ta koya masa ya sa fuskarsa cikin ruwa ya busa iska daga bakinsa.

A rana ta huɗu, wani abu ya auku. Wani ƙaramin yaro ya zame ya faɗa cikin ruwa mai zurfi. Ya nutse, ya fito, sai ya sake nutsewa. Malama Bashariya ta yi tsalle cikin ruwan, ta fito da yaron, ta kwantar da shi a ƙasa. Yaron ba ya numfashi. Ta danna ƙirjinsa, ta busa iska cikin bakinsa. Sai ya yi tari, ya farfaɗo.

Bayan abin da ya auku, Fu'ad ya ƙara gane muhimmancin iyo. Ya ce wa malamar, "Ina so in iya iyo kamar ke." A ranar ƙarshe, ya ratsa wurin iyon daga wannan gefe zuwa wancan gefe ba tare da taimako ba.

Da suka koma ƙauye, Fu'ad ya ce wa kakansa, "Kaka, yanzu na iya iyo. Amma har yanzu ba zan yi wasa kusa da rijiya ba." Kakansa ya yi dariya.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Fu'ad yake tsoron ruwa?
Saboda kakansa yakan faɗakar da shi cewa idan ya faɗa cikin rijiya zai nutse.
Me Malama Bashariya ta ce shi ne abu na farko a iyo?
Ta ce abu na farko shi ne nutsuwa.
Me ya auku a rana ta huɗu?
Wani ƙaramin yaro ya faɗa cikin ruwa mai zurfi ya nutse, amma malamar ta fito da shi, kuma ya farfaɗo.
Me Fu'ad ya yi a ranar ƙarshe?
Ya ratsa wurin iyon daga wannan gefe zuwa wancan gefe ba tare da taimako ba.

lessons.title: Farautar Ɗanasabe
lessons.summary: Near Bauchi, the old hunter Ɗanasabe takes his grandson Jazuli to the yearly hunting contest; he forbids making an animal suffer, tells a legend, smokes animals out of a smelly cave, the hunters dig out rats, and Jazuli learns not to eat raw meat before tasting the roast.
lessons.text:
Ɗanasabe tsoho ne mai shekaru 70 a wani ƙauye kusa da Bauchi. Tun yana matashi yake farauta. A ƙauyensu farauta wasa ce, kuma al'ada ce. Kowace shekara, kafin damina, mutanen ƙauyuka suna yin gasar farauta a daji.

A wannan shekara, jikansa Jazuli, wanda yake karatu a Bauchi, ya ce, "Kaka, ina so in bi ka farauta." Ɗanasabe ya ce, "To, amma ka saurari dokar farauta ta farko: kada mu azabtar da dabba. Idan mun kama dabba, mu yanka ta da sauri. Duk wanda ya azabtar da dabba ba mutumin farauta na gaskiya ba ne."

Da asuba suka shiga daji tare da wasu maza biyar da karnukansu. A hanya, Ɗanasabe ya ba Jazuli wani labarin almara game da wani mutum da ya kashe zaki da sanda kawai. Jazuli ya tambaye shi, "Kaka, wannan gaskiya ne?" Ɗanasabe ya yi dariya ya ce, "Almara ce, amma almara tana koya mana jarumtaka."

Bayan sun yi tafiya na awa biyu, suka isa wani kogo a gefen wani dutse. Wari mara daɗi yana fitowa daga cikin kogon. Ɗanasabe ya ce, "Wannan warin dabbobi ne. Akwai wani abu a cikin kogon." Suka hura wuta a bakin kogon, kuma hayaƙi ya shiga ciki. Ba a jima ba, sai wasu manyan ɓeraye suka fito da gudu daga cikin hayaƙin, sannan wani zomo ya biyo su.

Kusa da kogon akwai wasu ramuka a ƙasa. Ɗanasabe ya ce, "A nan ma akwai ɓeraye." Mazan suka tona ramukan da sanduna, suka ci gaba da tonawa har suka kama ɓeraye huɗu.

Da rana ta yi zafi, suka huta a ƙarƙashin bishiya. Suka gasa naman zomon da na ɓerayen a wuta. Ƙamshin naman ya cika wurin, kuma hayaƙin wutar ya tashi sama. Jazuli ya ji ƙamshin, sai ya so ya ci nama kafin ya nuna. Amma kakansa ya ce, "Kada ka ci ɗanyen nama. Ɗanyen nama yana kawo ciwon ciki." Da naman ya nuna, Jazuli ya ɗanɗana shi. Ya ce, "Ban taɓa ɗanɗana nama mai daɗi kamar wannan ba!"

Da yamma, alƙalan gasar suka ƙirga abin da kowace ƙungiya ta kama, kuma ƙungiyar Ɗanasabe ta zo ta biyu. Jazuli ya ce, "Kaka, shekara mai zuwa zan dawo. Kuma zan ba abokaina labarin almara na yau."

Tambayoyi:
Wace ce dokar farauta ta farko?
Dokar ta farko ita ce kada a azabtar da dabba.
Me Ɗanasabe ya ce game da labarin mutumin da ya kashe zaki?
Ya ce almara ce, amma almara tana koya musu jarumtaka.
Yaya suka fitar da ɓerayen daga kogon?
Sun hura wuta a bakin kogon, kuma hayaƙi ya shiga ciki, sai ɓerayen suka fito.
Me ya sa Ɗanasabe ya hana Jazuli cin nama da wuri?
Saboda ɗanyen nama yana kawo ciwon ciki.

lessons.title: Gwiwar Abdulkarim
lessons.summary: Abdulkarim, a long-distance runner in Kano who dreams of the African games, tears something in his knee; after surgery he misses running and loses heart, but the doctor Fanne gives him exercises, measures his weight, cuts his bread and explains the benefits of vegetables, and after four months he is healed and picked for the national team.
lessons.text:
Abdulkarim ɗan wasan gudu ne a Kano. Shi ne ya fi kowa gudun nesa a jiharsu. Muradinsa shi ne ya wakilci Najeriya a gasar ƙasashen Afirka.

Wata rana, a lokacin horo, ya ji ciwo mai tsanani a gwiwarsa ta dama. Ya tafi asibiti, kuma likita Fanne ta duba shi. Ta ce, "Wani abu a cikin gwiwarka ya yanke. Sai an yi maka tiyata." Abdulkarim ya damu. Ya tambaye ta, "Zan warke? Zan iya komawa gudu?" Likitar ta ce, "Tiyata za ta gyara gwiwar, amma ba ita kaɗai za ta warkar da kai ba. Sai ka yi haƙuri, kuma ka bi shawarata."

Aka yi masa tiyatar, kuma ta yi nasara. Bayan kwana uku ya koma gida. Amma a gida ba ya iya gudu, yana zaune kawai. Yana kewar gudu sosai. Kowace safiya, idan ya ji matasa suna gudu a titi, sai kewar filin wasa ta kama shi.

Mahaifiyarsa ta ce masa, "Gwiwarka tana warkewa, amma ruhinka ma yana buƙatar kulawa. Ka tuna da ruhin ɗan wasa: ba ya yarda ya faɗi ya kwanta."

Da ya koma asibiti, likita Fanne ta ba shi wasu motsa jiki masu sauƙi. Ta ce, "Waɗannan motsa jiki za su sauƙaƙa maka komawa gudu." Sannan ta auna nauyinsa, ta ce, "Nauyinka ya ƙaru saboda ba ka gudu. Ka rage cin burodi da shinkafa. Ka ci ganye da 'ya'yan itace. Suna da ma'adinai da jiki yake buƙata, kuma ma'adinai suna sa ƙashi ya yi ƙarfi."

Abdulkarim ya daina cin burodi da safe. Yakan ci kayan lambu, kuma yakan yi motsa jikin kowace rana. Kowane mako likitar tana auna nauyinsa. Ta ce masa, "Ka ga fa'idar abin da kake yi? Motsa jiki yana da fa'ida ba ga gwiwa kaɗai ba, har ma ga zuciya da ruhi."

Bayan wata huɗu, likitar ta ce, "Ka warke sosai. Ba magani kaɗai ne ya warkar da kai ba." Abdulkarim ya koma horo. Motsa jikin ya sauƙaƙa masa gudu, kuma bai ji ciwo ba.

A ƙarshen shekara, aka zaɓe shi cikin 'yan wasan da za su wakilci Najeriya. Muradinsa ya cika. Ya kira likita Fanne ya ce, "Na gode. Ke ce kika warkar da gwiwata, kuma kika warkar da ruhina."

Tambayoyi:
Wane muradi Abdulkarim yake da shi?
Muradinsa shi ne ya wakilci Najeriya a gasar ƙasashen Afirka.
Me ya sa aka yi masa tiyata?
Saboda wani abu a cikin gwiwarsa ya yanke a lokacin horo.
Me mahaifiyarsa ta ce game da ruhinsa?
Ta ce gwiwarsa tana warkewa, amma ruhinsa ma yana buƙatar kulawa.
Me ya sa likitar ta ce ya rage cin burodi?
Saboda nauyinsa ya ƙaru tun da ba ya gudu.

lessons.title: Rigimar 'yan wasan raga
lessons.summary: In Gombe, Nazira, head of a girls' volleyball team, shouts at her close friend Rumaisa during a match; they stop speaking and the team starts losing, the coach Malam Sharif threatens to remove Nazira as leader unless they settle it, she apologises with regret, they make peace and win the state championship.
lessons.text:
Nazira ita ce shugabar ƙungiyar ƙwallon raga ta 'yan mata a wata makarantar sakandare a Gombe. Rumaisa ita ce 'yar wasa mafi ƙarfi a ƙungiyar. Akwai kusanci sosai tsakaninsu, domin tun suna firamare suke tare.

Amma wata rana, a lokacin wani wasa, rigima ta taso tsakaninsu. Rumaisa ta buga ƙwallo, sai ƙwallon ya fita, kuma ƙungiyarsu ta rasa maki. Nazira ta yi mata ihu a gaban kowa: "Ba ki iya wasa ba!" Rumaisa ta ji kunya ta ce, "Ke ma ba ki iya shugabanci ba!" Rigimar ta yi zafi har sai da malamin wasanninsu, Malam Sharif, ya raba su.

Bayan haka, kusancin da ke tsakaninsu ya ɓace. Ba sa magana da juna. Idan Rumaisa ta gamu da Nazira a hanya, sai ta juya ta bi wata hanya. Wasu 'yan mata suka ce Rumaisa tana tsanar Nazira. Wasu kuma suka nuna ƙyama ga Nazira saboda ihun da ta yi, suka ce, "Bai kamata shugaba ta yi wa 'yar wasa ihu a gaban jama'a ba." Ƙyamar da suke nuna mata ta sa Nazira baƙin ciki. Ƙungiyar ta fara faɗuwa a wasanninta.

Malam Sharif ya kira taro. Ya ce, "Ƙungiyar da take cike da rigima ba za ta ci nasara ba. Nazira, ke ce shugaba, amma ihun da kika yi bai dace ba. Idan ba ku sasanta wannan rigima ba kafin gasar jiha, zan tsige ki daga shugabancin ƙungiyar." Nazira ta yi shiru. Ba ta so a tsige ta ba, kuma ta ji nadama a zuciyarta.

Da yamma, Nazira ta je gidan Rumaisa. Ta ce, "Rumaisa, ina neman afuwarki. Na yi nadama da abin da na faɗa." Rumaisa ta yi shiru na ɗan lokaci, sannan ta ce, "Ni ma ina neman afuwa. Ban tsane ki ba, Nazira. Haushi ne kawai na ji." Suka sasanta, suka rungumi juna, suka yi dariya.

Bayan kwana ɗaya suka gamu da Malam Sharif a filin wasa, suna tafiya tare. Ya ce, "Yanzu na ga ƙungiya!" Bai tsige Nazira ba. Kafin kowane wasa, Nazira tana ce wa 'yan wasanta, "Idan wata ta yi kuskure, mu ƙarfafa ta, kada mu yi mata ihu." A gasar jiha, ƙungiyarsu ta zo ta farko.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa akwai kusanci sosai tsakanin Nazira da Rumaisa?
Saboda tun suna firamare suke tare.
Yaya rigimar ta fara?
Rumaisa ta buga ƙwallo ya fita, sai Nazira ta yi mata ihu a gaban kowa.
Me Malam Sharif ya ce zai yi idan ba su sasanta ba?
Ya ce zai tsige Nazira daga shugabancin ƙungiyar.
Me Nazira ta ce wa Rumaisa a gidansu?
Ta ce tana neman afuwarta, kuma ta yi nadama da abin da ta faɗa.
Me ya faru a gasar jiha?
Ƙungiyarsu ta zo ta farko.

lessons.title: Ragon Malam Dandago
lessons.summary: In Katsina, Sumaila looks after his grandfather Malam Dandago's huge fighting ram, kept apart from the flock, and gathers its dung for the farm; after the imam leads the Sallah prayer the ram fights rams from other towns, no ram stands before it except a big black ram from Daura, which also runs in the end, and the district head honours the old man.
lessons.text:
Sumaila yaro ne ɗan shekara goma sha shida a Katsina. Kakansa Malam Dandago yana da wani gagarumin rago mai manyan ƙahoni da farin gashi. Ragon ya fi kowane rago a unguwarsu girma da ƙarfi.

A ƙasar Hausa, wasan raguna al'ada ce da ta wanzu tun zamanin kakanni. Malam Dandago ya ce wa jikansa, "Wannan al'ada ta wanzu shekaru ɗari da yawa, kuma ba za ta ɓace ba muddin muna nan."

Malam Dandago ya keɓe ragon tun yana ƙarami. Ba ya barin sa ya yi kiwo tare da sauran tumaki, kuma yana keɓe masa abinci na musamman: wake da ganye. Sumaila ne yake kula da shi. Yakan ba shi ruwa, yakan share wurin kwanciyarsa, kuma yakan tara takinsa a cikin buhu. Kakansa yakan zuba takin a gonarsa, domin takin rago yana sa hatsi ya yi kyau.

Da Babbar Sallah ta zo, mutane da yawa suka yanka raguna. Amma Malam Dandago bai taɓa yanka wannan ragon ba. Da safe, liman ya ja sallar idi a babban filin gari. Bayan sallah, liman ya yi wa jama'a wa'azi. Ya ce, "Ku tuna da talakawa a wannan rana, ku raba musu nama."

Da yamma, aka yi wasan raguna a wani fili kusa da gidan hakimi. Mutane sun zo da raguna daga Daura da wasu garuruwa. Ragon Malam Dandago ya fafata da raguna huɗu ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Uku na farko sun gudu da wuri. Babu ragon da ya tsaya a gabansa face na huɗu, wani babban rago baƙi daga Daura. Su biyun suka fafata na dogon lokaci, har ragon Daura ya juya ya gudu. Mutane suka yi ihu da tafi.

Bayan wasan, Malam Dandago da Sumaila suka je gidan hakimi. A ƙofar gida, Malam Dandago ya yi sallama, sai hakimi ya ce, "Ku shigo!" Hakimi ya karrama Malam Dandago da sabuwar riga da hula, kuma ya ce, "Ka kiyaye wannan al'ada, shi ya sa muke karrama ka." Babu wanda aka karrama a wannan rana face Malam Dandago.

Da dare ya yi, suka yi wa hakimi sallama suka koma gida. Sumaila ya ba ragon ruwa, ya ce masa, "Kai ne zakaran Katsina."

Tambayoyi:
Yaya ragon Malam Dandago yake?
Gagarumin rago ne mai manyan ƙahoni da farin gashi.
Me Sumaila yake yi da takin ragon?
Yakan tara shi a cikin buhu, kuma kakansa yakan zuba shi a gonarsa.
Me liman ya ce a wa'azinsa bayan sallar idi?
Ya ce jama'a su tuna da talakawa, su raba musu nama.
Wane rago ne ya tsaya a gaban ragon Malam Dandago?
Babu ragon da ya tsaya a gabansa face wani babban rago baƙi daga Daura.
Me hakimi ya yi wa Malam Dandago?
Ya karrama shi da sabuwar riga da hula.

lessons.title: Zaɓe a ƙungiyar 'yan gudu
lessons.summary: A Jos athletics club founded in 1975, the old chairman Alhaji Hamdan steps down and calls a democratic election with conditions for candidates; Abdulsalam's helper tries to buy votes, observers from the federation's headquarters in Abuja disqualify him, and the former runner Lalla wins, swears an oath to protect the club's property and comments that young athletes are its pillars.
lessons.text:
Ƙungiyar 'yan gudu ta Jos ta kafu a shekarar 1975. Tun kafuwarta, ta horar da 'yan wasa da yawa da suka wakilci Najeriya a gasa. Ƙungiyar tana da kadarori: filin gudu, motocin bas guda biyu, da wani gida a tsakiyar gari. Tana kuma da gidauniya, kuma gidauniyar tana biyan kuɗin makarantar matasan 'yan wasa marasa galihu.

Shugaban ƙungiyar, Alhaji Hamdan, ya yi shekaru ashirin yana shugabanci. Wata rana ya kira taron membobi ya ce, "Na tsufa, lokaci ya yi da zan huta. Ƙungiyarmu tana bin tsarin dimokuraɗiyya, don haka ku membobi ne za ku zaɓi sabon shugaba."

Sannan ya karanta sharuɗɗan takara: "Sharaɗi na farko: ɗan takara ya kasance cikin membobin ƙungiyar na shekara biyar. Sharaɗi na biyu: kada ya taɓa yin yaudara a wasa ko a aiki." Mutane biyu ne suka cika sharuɗɗan: Abdulsalam, wani attajiri mai shago, da Lalla, tsohuwar 'yar gudu wadda yanzu malamar makaranta ce.

Kafin ranar zaɓe, wani abokin Abdulsalam ya fara zuwa gidajen membobi yana ba su kuɗi, yana cewa su zaɓi Abdulsalam. Wata tsohuwar 'yar gudu ta ƙi karɓar kuɗin, ta ce, "Wannan yaudara ce. Dimokuraɗiyya ba ta sayar da ƙuri'a." Ta kai labarin ga Alhaji Hamdan.

Alhaji Hamdan ya kira hedkwatar hukumar wasanni ta ƙasa da ke Abuja. Hedkwatar ta aiko da wakilai biyu domin su kula da zaɓen. Wakilan suka bincika maganar, suka ce, "Abdulsalam bai cika sharaɗi na biyu ba, domin an yi yaudara da sunansa." Aka cire sunansa daga takarar.

A ranar zaɓe, membobi suka jefa ƙuri'a, kuma Lalla ta ci zaɓen. Ta tsaya a gaban membobi ta yi rantsuwa. A cikin rantsuwarta ta ce, "Na yi rantsuwa cewa zan kare kadarorin wannan ƙungiya, zan bi tsarin dimokuraɗiyya, kuma ba zan yi yaudara ba."

Bayan taron, wani ɗan jarida ya nemi tsokacinta. A tsokacinta, Lalla ta ce, "Matasan 'yan wasa su ne ginshiƙin wannan ƙungiya. Tsofaffin 'yan wasa kuma ginshiƙi ne na biyu, domin su ne suke koya musu. Zan ƙara kuɗin gidauniyar domin matasa da yawa su sami horo." Alhaji Hamdan ya yi murmushi, ya ce, "Na san ƙungiyar tana hannu mai kyau."

Tambayoyi:
Yaushe ƙungiyar 'yan gudu ta Jos ta kafu?
Ta kafu a shekarar 1975.
Wane aiki gidauniyar ƙungiyar take yi?
Tana biyan kuɗin makarantar matasan 'yan wasa marasa galihu.
Me sharaɗi na biyu na takara ya ce?
Kada ɗan takara ya taɓa yin yaudara a wasa ko a aiki.
Me ya sa aka cire sunan Abdulsalam daga takarar?
Saboda abokinsa ya yi yaudara da sunansa, yana ba membobi kuɗi.
Me Lalla ta ce a cikin rantsuwarta?
Ta ce za ta kare kadarorin ƙungiyar, za ta bi tsarin dimokuraɗiyya, kuma ba za ta yi yaudara ba.

lessons.title: Wasiƙa daga makarantar kwana
lessons.summary: In a letter from her boarding school in Zaria, Ummuhani tells her mother in Sokoto about inter-house sports: houses named by letters, a teacher who believes a healthy body helps the mind, revision of the rules, the javelin she knew nothing about, basketball's popularity, girls she met from another school, and the scoreboard her house tops.
lessons.text:
Zaria

Zuwa ga mahaifiyata a Sokoto,

Ina gaishe ki, Mama, da fatan kina lafiya, ke da Baba da ƙannena. Ni ma ina lafiya a makarantar kwana. Na san kina damuwa da karatuna, amma ina so in ba ki labarin wasannin da muka yi a wannan mako.

Makarantarmu makarantar boko ce, amma tana ilmantar da mu ba ta littattafai kaɗai ba, har ma ta wasanni. Wasanni suna ilmantar da mu game da haƙuri da aiki tare. Malamar wasanninmu tana da aƙidar cewa jiki mai lafiya yana taimakon ƙwaƙwalwa. Kullum tana cewa, "Ilimin boko ba ya cika sai da lafiyar jiki." Wannan aƙida ce da dukan malaman makarantar suka yarda da ita.

A makarantarmu akwai gidaje huɗu, kuma kowane gida yana da harafinsa, daga harafin farko zuwa na huɗu na haruffan boko. Gidana shi ne gidan harafi na biyu, kuma launinmu shuɗi ne. An rubuta harafin gidanmu a bayan rigunanmu.

Kafin gasar, malamar ta yi mana bitar dokokin kowane wasa. Bitar ta ɗauki awa biyu, amma ta taimake mu sosai.

Mama, a Sokoto ba ni da masaniya game da wasan jefa mashi. A nan na koyi shi. Yanzu ina da masaniya game da yadda ake riƙe mashi da yadda ake jefa shi. Malamar ta ce in yawaita horo, kuma in yawaita shan ruwa, domin rana tana da zafi. Na yawaita horo kowace yamma, kuma na zo ta biyu a jefa mashi!

Wasan ƙwallon kwando ma ya sami karɓuwa sosai a makarantarmu. A baya 'yan mata kaɗan ne suke yin sa, amma yanzu kowa yana so ya shiga. Karɓuwar wasan ta sa makarantar ta gina sabon filin kwando.

A ranar ƙarshe, wata makarantar 'yan mata daga Kaduna ta zo wasa da mu. Na sadu da wata yarinya wadda take buga tennis a wani kulob. Mun yi magana sosai, kuma mun yi alƙawarin za mu sake saduwa a hutu.

Da yamma, aka rubuta makin kowane gida a kan babban allo a gaban ɗakin taro. Kowa ya tsaya a gaban allon yana dubawa. Gidanmu, gidan harafi na biyu, ne ya zo na farko!

Ki gaida Baba. Ina kewarku sosai.

'Yarki,
Ummuhani

Tambayoyi:
Wace aƙida ce malamar wasanni take da ita?
Tana da aƙidar cewa jiki mai lafiya yana taimakon ƙwaƙwalwa.
Yaya aka sanya wa gidajen makarantar suna?
Kowane gida yana da harafinsa, daga harafin farko zuwa na huɗu.
Me malamar ta ce Ummuhani ta yawaita?
Ta ce ta yawaita horo, kuma ta yawaita shan ruwa.
Me ya nuna cewa wasan ƙwallon kwando ya sami karɓuwa?
Kowa yana so ya shiga, kuma makarantar ta gina sabon filin kwando.
Ina aka rubuta makin kowane gida?
An rubuta makin a kan babban allo a gaban ɗakin taro.

lessons.title: Keken Oumarou
lessons.summary: In Niamey, the cyclist Oumarou prepares for a race from Dosso a week before his wedding; his new bike of a French make is stolen from under its lock one morning, the policeman Seyni recovers it at the market, the young thief repents, the organisers carry the riders to Dosso by lorry, and Oumarou wins while his bride watches.
lessons.text:
Oumarou ɗan wasan keke ne a Niamey, babban birnin Nijar. Yana shirin wata babbar gasar keke daga garin Dosso zuwa Niamey. Gasar za ta kasance mako ɗaya kafin bikin aurensa da Zeinabou. Zeinabou ta ce, "Ka ci gasar nan, sannan ka zo ka auri amaryarka."

Oumarou yana da sabon keke na ƙirar Faransa. Kekuna na wannan ƙira ba su da nauyi, kuma suna da sauri sosai. Duk dare yakan ɗaure keken a jikin wani ƙarfe a farfajiyar gidansu, ya kulle shi da makulli, sannan ya ajiye makullin a aljihunsa.

Wata safiya, Oumarou ya farka da asuba domin ya yi horo. Ya saka suturar keke, ya fita farfajiya. Amma keken ba ya nan! Ya ga makullin a ƙasa, an karya shi. Ya yi ihu har mahaifiyarsa ta farka. Ta ce, "Me ya faru?" Ya ce, "An sace kekena, kwana huɗu kafin gasa!"

Ya tafi ofishin 'yan sanda, kuma wani ɗan sanda mai suna Seyni ya rubuta labarinsa. Seyni ya tambaye shi, "Wace irin ƙira ce kekenka?" Oumarou ya ce, "Ƙirar Faransa ce, kalarsa ja da fari." Seyni ya ce, "Kada ka damu, za mu yi ƙoƙari mu kwato shi."

Bayan kwana biyu, Seyni ya kira shi. Ya ce, "Mun kwato kekenka! Wani matashi yana neman sayar da shi a kasuwa." Da Oumarou ya isa ofishin, ya ga matashin zaune. Matashin ya ce, "Na tuba. Ba zan ƙara sata ba. Talauci ne ya sa na yi haka." Oumarou ya ji tausayinsa. Seyni ya ce, "Idan ya tuba da gaskiya, kotu za ta duba haka."

A ranar gasa, masu shirya gasar sun yi jigilar 'yan wasa da kekunansu daga Niamey zuwa Dosso a manyan motoci. Jigilar ta ɗauki awa biyu. A Dosso, 'yan wasa hamsin suka saka suturarsu, suka hau kekunansu, suka fara tafiya zuwa Niamey.

Hanyar tana da tsawo da zafi, amma Oumarou bai tsaya ba. Ya isa Niamey na farko. Mahaifiyarsa ta rungume shi, ta sumbaci goshinsa. Zeinabou tana tsaye a gefen titi cikin farar sutura, kuma kowa ya ce, "Ga amaryar zakara!" Oumarou ya ɗauki lambar yabonsa, ya sumbace ta, sannan ya miƙa wa Zeinabou.

Tambayoyi:
Wace irin ƙira ce keken Oumarou?
Kekensa na ƙirar Faransa ne.
Me Oumarou ya gani da ya farka da asuba?
Ya ga kekensa ba ya nan, kuma an karya makullin.
Ina 'yan sanda suka kwato keken?
Sun kwato shi a kasuwa, inda wani matashi yake neman sayar da shi.
Me matashin ya ce a ofishin 'yan sanda?
Ya ce ya tuba, kuma ba zai ƙara sata ba.
Yaya 'yan wasan suka isa Dosso?
Masu shirya gasar sun yi jigilarsu da kekunansu a manyan motoci.

lessons.title: Horon soja a Kaduna
lessons.summary: At the military academy in Kaduna, the cadet Abdulbasit takes part in a fitness exercise with cadets from neighbouring countries under a regional alliance; the commander orders them to retake a hill from a pretend invasion, Captain Amadou of Niger leads the scouting, they climb a ladder over a wall, use no real bullets, and win the flag.
lessons.text:
Abdulbasit ɗalibi ne a makarantar horar da sojoji a Kaduna. Kowace safiya, kafin rana ta fito, ɗaliban suna gudun kilomita goma, suna tsalle, kuma suna ɗaukar abubuwa masu nauyi. Abdulbasit yana son motsa jiki, amma wannan horo yana da wahala.

A wannan shekara, ɗalibai daga ƙasashe maƙwabta sun zo Kaduna domin wani babban horo na haɗin gwiwa. Ɗalibai daga Nijar da Chadi suka zo, domin akwai ƙawance tsakanin Najeriya da maƙwabtanta a kan tsaro. Kwamandan makarantar ya ce, "Wannan ƙawance yana nufin cewa maƙwabci yana taimakon maƙwabcinsa a lokacin wahala."

Da safe kwamandan ya tara su duka. Ya umarci ɗaliban su kasu ƙungiyoyi huɗu, kowace ƙungiya da ɗalibai daga ƙasashe uku. Abdulbasit yana ƙungiya ɗaya da Kyaftin Amadou, wani matashin soja daga Nijar. Kwamandan ya umarci Kyaftin Amadou ya zama shugaban ƙungiyar.

Kwamandan ya bayyana horon: "Wani maƙiyi na ƙarya ya yi mamaya a kan wani tudu da ke kusa. Kuna da awa shida ku kwato tudun, ku kawo tutar da ke samansa. Mamayar ba ta gaskiya ba ce, amma ku yi aiki kamar ta gaskiya ce."

Kyaftin Amadou ya ce, "Kafin mu je, sai mun yi leƙen asiri." Ya tura Abdulbasit da wani ɗalibi daga Chadi su yi leƙen asirin tudun. Su biyun suka yi rarrafe cikin ciyawa, suka ga cewa akwai wani dogon bango a gefen tudun, kuma babu masu tsaro a wajen. Suka koma suka faɗa wa Kyaftin.

Kyaftin Amadou ya ce, "Za mu bi ta bangon." Ƙungiyar ta ɗauki wani dogon tsani na katako. Suka ɗora tsanin a jikin bangon, suka hau ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Abdulbasit ya ji tsoro a saman tsanin, amma bai tsaya ba.

A wannan horo babu wanda yake da harsashi na gaske. Bindigoginsu suna harba harsashin roba ne kawai, domin kada kowa ya ji rauni. Duk da haka, da harsashin roba ya taɓa wani, sai ya fita daga wasan.

Ƙungiyar Kyaftin Amadou ta isa saman tudun kafin sauran ƙungiyoyi, kuma Abdulbasit ya ɗauki tutar. Kwamandan ya ce, "Kun yi aiki tare kamar 'yan'uwa. Wannan shi ne ma'anar ƙawance." Kyaftin Amadou ya rungumi Abdulbasit, ya ce, "Maƙwabci na gaskiya!"

Tambayoyi:
Daga ina ɗaliban da suka zo Kaduna suka fito?
Sun fito daga ƙasashe maƙwabta, Nijar da Chadi.
Me kwamandan ya umarci ɗaliban su yi da safe?
Ya umarce su su kasu ƙungiyoyi huɗu.
Me ya sa Kyaftin Amadou ya tura Abdulbasit?
Ya tura shi ya yi leƙen asirin tudun kafin ƙungiyar ta je.
Yaya ƙungiyar ta bi ta bangon?
Sun ɗora wani dogon tsani na katako a jikin bangon, suka hau ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
Me ya sa ba a yi amfani da harsashi na gaske ba?
Domin kada kowa ya ji rauni a horon.
